rules: AGENTS.md and docs/development.md require inward dependencies and SDK/effect ownership in outer adapters; existing executable import contracts remain authoritative.

modules.responsibility: Own ClearML invocation publication, shutdown and terminal status under a finite owner-thread deadline.
modules.interface: invocation retains its API and failure guarantees; shared finalization deadline changes from 60 to 600 seconds for direct and queued runs.
modules.effects: Session owns task/network lifecycle; deadline helper owns temporary main-thread alarm. No effects or imports move.

contracts.rules: Layer direction, SDK ownership and adapter peer import restrictions.
Exhaustive module classification and forbidden-edge negative cases enforce SDK and effect ownership.

checks.expectation: Production graph passes; injected forbidden dependencies are rejected.
Deadline interruption, alarm restoration, failure preservation, owner quarantine and terminal status regressions pass.

checks.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync python scripts/check_docs.py docs/runtime-isolation.md docs/diagnostics.md .specify/bugs/clearml-finalization-timeout/assessment.md .specify/bugs/clearml-finalization-timeout/fix.md .specify/bugs/clearml-finalization-timeout/test.md
checks.expectation: Changed Markdown and local links/anchors pass.

documentation: Update current runtime-isolation and diagnostics timeout text; portable usage examples remain unchanged after inspection. Preserve dated historical evidence.

review.reviewer: Parent proportionate review for a one-line constant change after verification
review.reconciliation: Inspected the full task-owned diff and all new bug artifacts. Only the session deadline value changes at runtime. Current docs and existing import/effect contracts match. Local dependency overrides and unrelated untracked grid-search documentation are preserved. Generated changelog and later root version metadata follow the native release workflow; no dependency changes are authorized.
